text: Cantina Fantini is the wine brand of the Fantini Group of Ortona, Abruzzo (formerly Farnese Vini), which US private-equity firm Platinum Equity acquired from NB Renaissance Partners in March 2020.
short: The Fantini Group (Cantina Fantini wines) is owned by US private-equity firm Platinum Equity.

source.name: Platinum Equity — portfolio: Fantini Group
source.quote: Fantini Group acquires grapes from local farmers, produces and markets wines under specialty labels to customers internationally
source.note: Same page, 'Transaction Description': 'Acquired from NB Renaissance Partners in March 2020'.
